name: branch-usage
description: Tracks tokens and cost per model, agent and session for every session on a git branch, in a right pane.

prices.title: Price overrides
prices.description: JSON: {"<model id prefix>": {"in": 3, "out": 15, "cacheRead": 0.3, "cacheWrite": 3.75}} in $ per million tokens. Empty uses the built-in table.
